teaser: The flickering sign over an all-night diner buzzes and catches, and you are the one everyone at the counter watches without quite meaning to. Life path 11 asks for a kind of quiet conduction, a channel for something larger than the moment; ESFP asks for a kind of loud presence, a life built in full view. Crossed, the two make an odd current: you carry something heavy and carry it openly, cracking jokes, catching eyes, somehow making the room lighter while the thing moving through you stays the same weight it always was. The static between those two pulls is the real subject here.
excerpt: Attention gets paid first to the room, then to the person in it, a scan nearly automatic before focus narrows to one face.
